**Preferred term label**
Unclassified Fallopian Tube Progenitor (UCFP)

**Synonyms** (add reference(s), please)
Prior work (PMID: 35320732) has referred to similar UCFP cells as clusters 2-1 and 2-2 that can give rise to epithelial and endothelial/stromal cell types through scRNA-seq and trajectory inference.

**Definition** (free text, with reference(s), please. PubMed ID format is PMID:XXXXXX)
We propose a new, broad definition for the observed "dual-feature" human fallopian tube progenitor-like cells that simultaneously express epithelial (e.g., EpCAM/CD326) and endothelial (e.g., PECAM1/CD31) markers, both on the cell surface and by RNA expression that can give rise to ciliated and secretory cell types, and potentially to endothelial/stromal cell types. These "dual-feature" unclassified fallopian tube progenitor cells have primary been observed by single-cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq), flow cytometry, and immunofluorescence, with the UCFP term proposed in PMID: 40475517.

**Parent cell type term** (check the hierarchy here https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/cl)
I am not entirely sure as these could exist under CL:4052019 or CL:4052018. 

**Anatomical structure where the cell type is found** (check Uberon for anatomical structures: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/uberon)
Human fallopian tube

0000-0002-1482-1032

comments.body: Looks good, but would prefer something like 'dual-feature fallopian tube progenitor cell' as a name. I guess 'unclassified' is historical at this point - you just classified it.
Discussion with Ben: He is happy with us using `dual-feature fallopian tube progenitor cell` as the main label in CL.

**Updates on text and logical defs (have been reviewed by @biobenkj ):**

**label**
dual-feature fallopian tube progenitor cell

**textual definition**

A bipotent progenitor cell within the human fallopian tube epithelium, characterized by the concurrent expression of epithelial (e.g., EpCAM/CD326) and endothelial (e.g., PECAM1/CD31) markers at both the cell surface and transcript levels. This cell has the capacity to differentiate into ciliated and secretory epithelial cells, as well as potentially endothelial/stromal lineages. Positioned at the apex of lineage bifurcation, the cell exhibits stem-like and endothelial features, representing an intermediate developmental state between undifferentiated progenitors and lineage-committed epithelial cells.

 PMID: [40475517](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40475517/)

**Synonyms**

non-ciliated secretory epithelial cell 2-1 (NCSE2-1 cells) - related synonym -  PMID: [35320732](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35320732/)
non-ciliated secretory epithelial cell 2-2 (NCSE2-2 cells) - related synonym -  PMID: [35320732](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35320732/)
unclassified fallopian tube progenitors - exact-  PMID: [40475517](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40475517/)

**Logical definition:**

'progenitor cell'
'part of' some 'fallopian tube epithelium'
'in taxon' some 'Homo sapiens'
'develops into' some 'fallopian tube secretory epithelial cell'
'develops into' some 'fallopian tube multiciliated epithelial cell'
